notes:
{和紙|わし} is traditional Japanese handmade paper, prized for its beauty, durability, and versatility. Made from plant fibers such as ⟦{楮|こうぞ}→楮：noentry⟧ (mulberry), ⟦{三椏|みつまた}→三椏：noentry⟧ (mitsumata), and ⟦{雁皮|がんぴ}→雁皮：noentry⟧ (gampi).

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Stronger and more durable than machine-made paper
- Translucent, with natural texture
- UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage (since 2014)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧: sliding paper screens
- ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧: calligraphy
- ⟦{折り紙|おりがみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧: origami
- ⟦{提灯|ちょうちん}→提灯：05800_chouchin⟧: paper lanterns

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和紙|わし}: Japanese paper ({和|わ} = Japanese)
- ⟦{洋紙|ようし}→洋紙：16912_youshi⟧: Western-style paper ({洋|よう} = Western)
